## Summary

The addition of multi-currency support to the expense approval workflow would require updating various threshold comparisons across the codebase to ensure that monetary amounts are correctly evaluated against policy limits and budgets when they are in different currencies. This would involve identifying comparisons between amounts and limits that need to be adjusted for currency conversion and potentially updating the underlying data structures to handle multiple currencies.
